01  —  The Maison

Scent is not worn.
It is remembered.

Maison Ardent composes fragrance as a form of living architecture—built in light, shadow and time.

Each extrait is made slowly in Grasse and released only when every note has found its place. No seasons. No spectacle. Only materials of uncommon depth.

The Composition

Not a list
of ingredients.
A passage of time.

Lueur unfolds in three movements. Scroll slowly.

010203

I · The First Impression

Top
Notes

A flash of brightness. Saffron warmed by skin, bergamot peel broken between the fingers.

  • Bergamot
  • Saffron
  • Pink Pepper

00 — 20 min

II · The Identity

Heart
Notes

The composition draws closer. Rose absolute opens into powdered iris and the clean grain of cedar.

  • Rose Absolute
  • Orris
  • Cedarwood

20 min — 4 hr

III · The Memory

Base
Notes

What remains: resinous oud, soft leather and amber made intimate by a trace of musk.

  • Oud
  • Leather
  • Amber
  • Musk

4 — 12 hr
